title: OTP Input
content: Build OTP/verification code input component. Structure: row of individual digit inputs (4-6 boxes). Input styling: w-12 h-14 text-2xl text-center border rounded-lg. Auto-advance: automatically focus next input after entering digit. Backspace: delete and move to previous. Paste support: distribute pasted code across inputs. Error state: shake animation, red border. Resend code: link with countdown.

variants.simple: Create row of single-digit inputs for entering verification codes.
variants.detailed: Build OTP/verification code input component. Structure: row of individual digit inputs (4-6 boxes). Input styling: w-12 h-14 text-2xl text-center border rounded-lg. Auto-advance: automatically focus next input after entering digit. Backspace: delete and move to previous. Paste support: distribute pasted code across inputs. Error state: shake animation, red border. Resend code: link with countdown.
variants.advanced: Build OTP/verification code input component with excellent UX. Structure: row of individual digit inputs (configurable length: 4, 6, or custom), flex gap-2 or gap-3 for spacing. Input styling: w-12 h-14 (or w-10 h-12 for compact), text-2xl font-medium text-center, border-2 rounded-lg, focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2. Auto-advance: onInput, if single digit entered, automatically focus next input using refs array. Backspace handling: onKeyDown, if Backspace pressed and current input empty, focus previous input; if has value, delete it. Paste support: onPaste handler intercepts paste event, extracts digits from clipboard text, distributes across inputs starting from current, prevents default paste. Selection: select all content on focus (input.select()) for easy overwrite. Separator: optional dash or space between groups for 6-digit codes (XXX-XXX), achieved with margin or literal separator element. Validation: accept only digits (0-9), use inputMode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]*" for mobile numeric keyboard, prevent non-digit input. Submit: auto-submit when all digits filled (trigger onComplete callback), or show explicit "Verify" button that becomes enabled. Resend code: "Didn't receive code? Resend" link with countdown timer ("Resend in 30s"), disabled during countdown, increments with each resend, uses setInterval. Expiry: optionally show code expiration countdown ("Code expires in 2:30") if API provides expiry time. Error state: shake animation (CSS keyframes for horizontal shake), red border (border-red-500), "Invalid code" message, clear inputs. Success: green borders (border-green-500), brief success state before redirect. Accessibility: wrap in fieldset with legend describing purpose, or use single visually-hidden input with aria-label, announce errors to screen readers with aria-live. Handle autofill: some browsers/apps autofill OTP from SMS, handle via onChange.
